key_insight: The paper shows that a 7-qubit NV-center spin register can achieve near-threshold, high-fidelity two-qubit gates, making solid-state quantum network nodes more viable.
engineering_relevance: This work advances scalable distributed quantum computing by demonstrating multi-qubit control with fidelities high enough to support fault-tolerant networked operation.
method: Built a 7-qubit register from nuclear spins coupled to a nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond
Analyzed and mitigated crosstalk in a highly connected spin system
Used an efficient optimization workflow and gate set tomography to characterize gate performance
evidence_signal: The abstract reports two-qubit gate fidelities of 99.61(5)% best and 99.18(2)% average, and validates the platform with VQE simulations of H2 and LiH.
watch_item: Despite strong fidelities, maintaining error thresholds across larger, more complex multi-qubit registers remains a key implementation challenge.
paper_title: High-fidelity two-qubit gates in a 7-qubit register for quantum networks
